sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Lone Shadow Vilehand (孤影衆 忌み手, Lone Shadow Forbidden Hand) is an optional Mini-Boss with two Deathblow Counters.
He'll occupy the Ashina Dojo, where Ashina Elite - Jinsuke Saze was previously found, after the castle has been invaded for the first time by the Central Forces.
Unlike the other Lone Shadows Wolf fought up to this point, he can inflict Poison with his fist.
He is accompanied by an Interior Ministry Agent.
As the Eight Prayer Necklace states, the Lone Shadows are the seventeen sons of Matsuna Oribe and the most trusted agents of the Interior Ministry.
